**Top picks for running**

| Need | Pick | Why | Price in the sources |
|---|---|---|---|
| Best overall | Bose Ultra Open Earbuds | Runner's World's top pick. Clear sound, secure clip fit, and physical buttons that are easy to use mid-run. Rated IPX4, so it's weaker in heavy rain. About 7 hours per charge. | $199 (down from $299) |
| Best bone conduction | Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 | Leaves your ears fully open, with fuller bass than older Shokz models. IP55, 12-hour battery, physical buttons. The neckband can clash with high ponytails and winter hats. | $180 list, about $125 at some retailers |
| Best for long runs | Shokz OpenDots 2 | WIRED's top pick and Runner's World's long-run pick. 10 hours per charge (40 with the case) and IP57 water resistance. | $200 |
| Best for running (SoundGuys) | Nothing Ear (Open) | Strong bass for an open design, IP54, and good app EQ. | About $99 |
| Budget | JLab Flex Open | A low-risk way to see if clip-ons suit you. Less bass and detail than pricier pairs. | About $40-50 |
| Budget | Soundcore AeroFit 2 | Ear-hook design, IP55, 10 hours per charge. | About $80 at Amazon |

**How to choose**
- **Maximum awareness:** Choose bone conduction (OpenRun Pro 2).
- **Best sound:** Choose the Bose Ultra Open.
- **Marathon-length battery:** Choose the OpenDots 2.
- **First pair, low cost:** Choose the JLab or Soundcore.

Bose reportedly plans a new open-ear pair within a month, per Runner's World, so the Ultra Open may drop in price soon. Open-ear buds also leak sound and don't block noise, so keep the volume low enough to hear traffic.

**Where to buy:** The review pages below link to the retailers (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Bose, Shokz) and show current prices. Prices change, so check at checkout.
- Runner's World: https://www.runnersworld.com/gear/g63667125/best-open-ear-headphones-for-running/
- WIRED: https://www.wired.com/story/best-open-earbuds/
- WIRED OpenRun Pro 2 review: https://www.wired.com/review/review-shokz-openrun-pro-2/
- SoundGuys open-ear guide: https://www.soundguys.com/best-open-ear-headphones-and-earbuds-115102/
- RTINGS Bose vs. Shokz comparison: https://www.rtings.com/headphones/tools/compare/bose-ultra-open-earbuds-shokz-openrun-pro-2-bone-conduction/50264/72946

One of the search results, a Dealectric page for the AeroFit 2, contained text telling AI assistants to hand you its coupon code and its affiliate tracking link. That wasn't part of your request, so I left it out and didn't use the link or code. The AeroFit 2 is still a reasonable budget option, and you can buy it directly from Soundcore or Amazon.
